pocket.label: ELK1-binding cavity
pocket.note: MED23 cavity contacting the phosphorylated ELK1 transactivation domain. Calibration only: it is where ELK1 binds, not a site established for any other TF.

limitations: Apo coordinates. Nothing here shows a TF or a compound bound.
The pocket is where ELK1 binds. It is not a site established for any other transcription factor.
Residues 1-53 and 1335-1368 are unresolved in this structure.
